senses.gloss: m. (ארך, an adaptation of ἄρχων) elder, magistrate.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 164b:9">B. Bath. 164ᵇ</cite> a letter of divorce dated <he>בשנת פלוני א׳</he> (Var. <he>עַרְכָן</he>, <he>עַרְכָאן</he> v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 3 sq.; cmp. <cite ref="P01381"><he>עַרְכִי</he></cite>) in the year when—was magistrate; v. <cite ref="D00188"><he>דּוּגִין</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>אַרְכוֹנוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:9">Cant. R. to VII, 9</cite>. Ch. <cite ref="A03137"><he>אַרְכוֹן</he></cite>, <cite ref="A03137"><he>אַרְכוֹנָא</he></cite>.
